messages.text:
Create a new SVG card in portrait orientation. Use the images from the resources folder. Call internal.CreateCard first to get a guid, then internal.DrawCard with the full SVG document. Use EXACTLY the SVG provided between <svg>...</svg> with no extra text.

<svg width="480" height="640" viewBox="0 0 480 640" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect width="480" height="640" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
  <image href="resource:josie.png" x="0" y="0" width="480" height="400" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
  <rect width="480" height="240" y="400" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cccccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="240" y="430" font-family="Georgia" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333">Portrait Gallery</text>
  <text x="240" y="460" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#666666">Featuring Moondream2 Vision Analysis</text>
  <text x="240" y="490" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#999999">ChatLlama 2026</text>
  <rect x="60" y="520" width="360" height="1" fill="#dddddd"/>
  <text x="240" y="560" font-family="Arial" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#666666">Screenshot recognized and described by AI</text>
  <text x="240" y="580" font-family="Arial" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#666666">using Moondream2 vision model on GPU</text>
</svg>
